study.title: Research on Buckwheat Weed Recognition in Multispectral UAV Images Based on MSU-Net
study.short_title: Buckwheat: MSU-Net adaptive 5-band input mIoU 0.65, F1 0.78; 77 FPS

segmentation.domain: MSU-Net (U-Net with adaptive multispectral input module + Swish activation) for weed recognition in multispectral UAV imagery of buckwheat fields (Shanxi, China); explores single-band vs multi-band input optimization and builds large-scene weed maps for variable-rate weeding path planning
models_tested: MSU-Net (proposed: adaptive multi-channel band-selection input module, Swish activation)
segmentation.best_model: MSU-Net with R+G+B+NIR input and Swish activation: mPA 0.76, mIoU 0.65, Dice 0.85, F1 0.78; best single band B: mPA 0.75, mIoU 0.61, Dice 0.87, F1 0.80

dataset.name: Self-built buckwheat-field multispectral dataset (Shanxi Agricultural University experimental field, Taigu District, Jinzhong, Shanxi, ~80 acres): 5 spectral bands (R 650, G 560, B 450, NIR 840, RedEdge 730 nm) captured 5 Aug 2023 during weed-dominant growth stage
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 multispectral UAV: visible + 5 multispectral cameras (1600x1300 px TIFF each, 2 Mp, TimeSync + RTK, GS Pro missions), flight speed 2.6 m/s, heading overlap 80%, lateral 70%. Inputs sliced to 256x256 (sliding window step 256, no overlap); annotation in Labelme (RGB reference) with all weed types uniformly labeled as one category. Horizontal/vertical flip, rotation, gaussian blur, gaussian noise, sharpen, affine augmentation (5 of 11 random methods per sample).

segmentation.backbone: U-Net encoder-decoder + adaptive #-channel input module + Swish activation (replacing ReLU to avoid neuron death); RTX 3080 (32 GB RAM), PyTorch 1.13.0, CUDA 11.7/CUDNN 8.4.1, lr 1e-5, wd 1e-8, 200 epochs, 256x256 input

mIoU.quote: The R+G+B+NIR band combination performs the best, with mPA, mIoU, Dice, and F1 values of 0.76, 0.65, 0.85, and 0.78, respectively, and this combination was optimal.
mIoU.section: 3. 3 Multispectral Combination Weed Identification Results / Table 3
mIoU.ambiguity: Best configuration MSU-Net + R+G+B+NIR + Swish. Without Swish the same band set gives mIoU 0.60-0.64 across configurations; single-band B inputs give mIoU 0.61; ReLU baseline mIoU 0.56. Confidence 0.9 - value read directly from Table 3 row 5.

mPA.quote: The R+G+B+NIR band combination performs the best, with mPA, mIoU, Dice, and F1 values of 0.76, 0.65, 0.85, and 0.78, respectively
mPA.ambiguity: Mean pixel accuracy averaged over classes (k+1 categories incl. background); high mPA inflated by large background areas, as the authors note.

F1.quote: The R+G+B+NIR band combination performs the best, with mPA, mIoU, Dice, and F1 values of 0.76, 0.65, 0.85, and 0.78, respectively
F1.ambiguity: Overall (macro) F1 on the best band combo; not class-specific.

Dice.quote: The R+G+B+NIR band combination performs the best, with mPA, mIoU, Dice, and F1 values of 0.76, 0.65, 0.85, and 0.78, respectively
Dice.ambiguity: Dice coefficient (=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN)) on the best band combo.

PA.ambiguity: The paper defines PA (ratio of correctly classified pixels) and reports mean-PA (mPA) across classes, not an overall PA that matches our PA field.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1; only overall F1 and per-band mIoU/Dice.

edge.device: Desktop: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080, Intel i7-12700F@2.10 GHz, 32 GB RAM, Windows 10

fps.quote: MSU-Net ... Parameters 3.10 x 10^7, FLOPs/G 54.78, FPS/(f s-1) 77.18
fps.ambiguity: Measured on desktop RTX 3080; edge.reported=false (no on-board/embedded deployment). Baseline U-Net 56.36 FPS, DenseASPP 13.5, PSPNet 9.2, DeepLabv3 12.8.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Derived as 1000/77.18 from the desktop RTX 3080 FPS measurement - NOT an edge deployment.

params_M.ambiguity: Structural param count (3.10e7); edge.reported=false. GPU memory consumption 118 MB (U-Net 98 MB, DenseASPP 40.5, PSPNet 264.81, DeepLabv3 237.68).

gflops.ambiguity: Structural FLOPs for 4-band input; baseline U-Net 53.64 G, DenseASPP 10.77 G, PSPNet 63.94 G, DeepLabv3 60.53 G (RGB 3-channel inputs).

issues: edge.reported=false: all metrics on desktop RTX 3080; no on-board UAV deployment or edge measurement.

Best result uses the optimal 4-band combo R+G+B+NIR (adaptive input). Five single-band and 9 multi-band inputs explored; more bands not always better (full 5-band combo slightly worse than R+G+B+NIR).
Swish activation key contribution (mIoU +9% vs ReLU). mPA inflated by large background, noted by authors.
All weed species at 30 m altitude uniformly labeled as a single weed class (no species differentiation).
Large-scene weed maps (256x256 sliding windows) for variable-rate spraying/path planning; FPS/latency desktop-only.
